title: Just finished the first proper boss fight for my game!
author: RealAstropulse
selftext:
Took a bit to get right, but it feels pretty good. I need to test some more runs to see how balanced it is into later game (20+ minutes) when the difficulty starts ramping up

You can play the game right now [here](https://astropulse.github.io/nova-play/)! This boss isn't in yet but it will be once I do some more testing and balance passes. Plenty of other things to find!

comments.author: Revelation12Studios
comments.body: Neat! Good job. What have you used for the sound effects?

replies.author: RealAstropulse
replies.body: Music is suno, the sound effects are [https://sfxr.me/](https://sfxr.me/)

comments.author: HealthyWest6482
comments.body: oh man. I had a shower thought earlier - you know what really sell this? action freeze / time dilation on damage taken (think hollow knight) + a distortion effect on certain actions (boost, big hits).  maybe a small weighted 'freeze' + light bloom on boost to sell the weight. I've been adding those effects to my project lately and it really creates a sense of physics
